name: zones_t17_create_lot_facing_minus_one
description: Conformance test 17 (CreateLotIfPossible with facing -1, §9 Z2c): the seeding rule from handoff §5.4. On a free 2 × 2 zoned rect with the generator at lcg := 1, CreateLotIfPossible(x, z, w, h, facing -1) makes EXACTLY ONE U(4) draw on the shared ZoneDeveloperStatics. With no road the drawn order r, r+1, r+2, r+3 finds no side, so CreateLotToFaceRoad uses the list front (facing r = 0). It returns ok with a lot (one reference for the caller). Seed 1 -> NextRaw 0x000041C6 -> U(4) = 0.
